item.title: Discuz! X5.0 Race Condition + CAPTCHA-Solving Pre-Auth to RCE Chain (CVE-2026-49952)
item.description:

Tags discuz, php, forum, race-condition, captcha-bypass, ocr, account-takeover, lfi, webshell, rce, pre-auth
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Discuz! X5.0 (PHP-based forum/CMS software)
Versions Affected Discuz! X5.0
Language / Platform PHP (target application), Python 3 (exploit tooling: requests, PyTorch/Pillow for CAPTCHA OCR)
Authentication Required No (pre-authentication chain; the exploit registers its own account as part of the attack)
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

This is a multi-stage, pre-auth-to-RCE exploit chain against Discuz! X5.0 that combines several bugs: an authcode-based DB export/import feature is abused to leak the admin’s username and MD5 password hash from a database backup; the exploit then registers a “special” crafted username containing that MD5 hash, solves the site’s login CAPTCHA using a bundled PyTorch OCR model, and wins a race condition between the DB-import process and the login flow to obtain an authenticated admin session cookie. From there it resets the admin password, logs into admincp, uploads a PHP webshell disguised as a PNG image via the header-nav icon upload feature, and abuses the plugin import/enable functionality (Local File Inclusion) to execute the disguised PHP stager, yielding an interactive webshell.

item.title: PolarLearn Forum Vote Count Manipulation (CVE-2026-25126)
item.description:
Metadata

Field Value

Last Updated 2026-01
Author / Researcher Joshua van Rijswijk (Jvr2022)
CVE / Advisory CVE-2026-25126
Category web
Severity Medium
CVSS Score Not specified in source
Status PoC
Tags business-logic, vote-manipulation, input-validation, api-abuse, forum, nodejs, ghost-downvote
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System PolarLearn forum platform
Versions Affected Version prior to the fix referenced in GHSA-ghpx-5w2p-p3qp
Language / Platform Node.js 18+ (PoC), target is a web API
Authentication Required Yes (valid authenticated session cookie)
Network Access Required Yes

Summary

CVE-2026-25126 is a business logic flaw in PolarLearn’s forum voting API. The POST /api/v1/forum/vote endpoint declares a TypeScript type for the direction field but never validates it at runtime, so the server accepts arbitrary string values instead of only "up", "down", or null. Downstream vote-handling logic treats any unexpected non-null value as an implicit downvote while still persisting it, and alternating an invalid value with a null “reset” lets an authenticated user repeatedly decrement a post’s score. The included PoC automates this cycle against a live target to demonstrate so-called “ghost downvotes.”
